formula_text: v = a + (b * U_br^2 / (Ts - Tf))^e  (NOT the SVMtec formula)

fit.remark: a and e ended exactly at their search limits

notes: Used by read_hotwire.py until 2026-10-01, e.g. for the measurements of 25.11.2025. It was fitted with a different formula than read_hotwire.py uses, so those velocities are 25-38 % too low. Corrected copies are in recomputed_velocity/. Do not use.
